newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet to rebuild N.Skog machine.
newsitem.headline: Valmet to rebuild N.Skog machine.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Monday it won an order worth over 100 million markka to rebuild Norwegian forest industry group Norske Skogsindustrier ASA's SC-paper machine at Halden.
"The order, valued at more than 100 million markka, will be finished in April 1998," Valmet said.

The purpose of the modernisation is to improve the paper quality of the machine at Norske Skog's Halden mill, where three machines produce close to 600,000 tonnes per year of SC (super-calandered) paper (or magazine paper), it said.
The main targets of the paper quality improvement were "smoothness, gloss and symmetry," Valmet said.
